verdict.rationale: Read receipts and open tracking are a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Gmail telling a sender whether or when recipients opened a message. The cited send API, undo-send, snooze, and push-notification docs cover sending and mailbox changes, not recipient open status. The community note on IMAP read-status sync concerns the user's own mailbox across devices, not recipient opens.
